full_judgment: 4. Mr. Sajjad Ali Chaudhury, the learned Advocate for the petitioner, submits that the petitioner who was defendant No. 10 has got prima facie case as no notice/summons of the partition suit was served upon the petitioner after remand of the suit to the trial Court and that there was an agreement between the parties to file a solenama before the appellate Court but without filing the same, the plaintiff of the partition suit surreptitiously got the said decree in the trial Court after remand without serving any notice upon the present petitioner. He further submits that although the subsequent suit has been dismissed for default, the petitioner has taken a Misc. case under Order 9 rule 9 of the Code of Civil Procedure and he has bright chance of getting back the suit restored to its file and number. On this two fold arguments Mr. Choudhury submits that the Rule should be made absolute and further proceeding of the execution case should be stayed.
